messages:
eng-sre-bot: Paging on-call: Elevated FN_CALL error rate + GPU saturation observed in prod-us-west-2-gpu-pool. Incident RWI-20260315-22. 500s from /v1/generate with tool calls and structured_json payloads. Auto-throttle kicked in. Metric: fncall_error_rate 18% (baseline <1%), avg token latency > 2.5s.
Aisha Khan: taking it. hopping into bridge now — any obvious suspects? recent deploys?
Tom Li: I saw a canary push ~40m ago that modified batching logic for tool-invoke. Not sure if it touched routing.
Aisha Khan: on bridge — confirming service logs show repeated kv-cache misses and retries back to python agent. Looks correlated with large streaming structured responses.
Marta Rivera: support: customers are seeing tool-call failures as of ~14:12Z. No wide data exfil. Critical customers: alpha-corp and beta-saas experiencing errors in 5% of requests.
Aisha Khan: immediate mitigation plan: 1) restrict fncall for public/anonymous clients, 2) reduce structured_json max size and fall back to plain text for heavy routes, 3) add temporary rate caps on /v1/generate for web tier. Will roll changes in 1-2 min canary.
Tom Li: agree. Suggest also switching auto-fallback to model-compat variant (gpt-legacy-q4 => gpt-compat-q4a) for heavy streams to reduce kernel pressure.
Aisha Khan: executing step 1. Running:
```bash
# disable function/tool-calls globally for public tier (emergency)
redwoodctl feature set fncall.enabled=false --scope=public --note="emergency backpressure RWI-20260315-22"
```
Aisha Khan: applied. Observability: fncall request count drops ~60% within 30s. CPU on pool down ~18%.
eng-sre-bot: Action logged: feature toggle fncall.enabled=false by Aisha Khan. Alert suppression for repeated fncall errors until 1948609383.
Marta Rivera: Support note drafted: "We are temporarily restricting function/tool invocation for public API keys to protect overall availability. If you are experiencing errors, contact support for whitelist options." Sending to channel #support now.
Support Bot: Message posted to #support and queued for customer emails (low-latency batch).
Tom Li: executing step 2 (structured JSON size cap).
```bash
# enforce smaller structured output payloads at the edge
redwoodctl config apply --path /routes/generate/response/structured_max_tokens=128 --env prod --note="shorten structured json to mitigate KV spike"
```
Tom Li: also adding a soft rate cap on web tier to shed excess load:
```bash
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate --rate-limit 1200rps --burst 300 --note "temporary shed RWI-20260315-22"
```
Aisha Khan: switching 10% canary to fallback model variant for heavy routes:
```bash
redwoodctl rollout start --route /v1/generate --model gpt-compat-q4a --traffic 10 --note "backpressure canary"
```
Aisha Khan: observing canary for 2 minutes. If stable, will increase to 50%.
Marta Rivera: Customer impact update: alpha-corp reduced error rate from 5% -> 1.8% after fncall toggle. Beta-saas still at ~2.2%. Including recommended action: whitelist dedicated key or use dedicated capacity.
Tom Li: logs show fewer kv-cache evictions after structured cap. Latency trending down.
Aisha Khan: increasing fallback to 50% for heavy traffic.
eng-sre-bot: Rollout update: gpt-compat-q4a at 50% for /v1/generate. Monitoring health checks.
Marta Rivera: sent proactive comms to alpha-corp support contact with temporary mitigation steps and timeline estimate (~2-4 hrs for full normalization).
Tom Li: prepping a short-lived quota bump for enterprise tenants to avoid throttling legit high-value traffic while limits in place. Running:
```bash
redwoodctl quota adjust --tenant alpha-corp --increase 2x --ttl 3h --note "temporary to avoid customer throttling during mitigation"
```
Aisha Khan: OK—status check: error-rate down to 3.1%, token latency 1.2s, GPU pool usage still above desired but stable. Next: engage oncall rotation for handoff in 15m.
Tom Li: I'm available for handoff. If anything regresses, escalate to platform pager. Leaving bridge in 10.
Marta Rivera: I'll keep a customer-facing status line and patch support docs with workaround (disable structured mode client-side, retry with backoff).
Aisha Khan: Handoff notes for next oncall:
- What we did: disabled public fncalls, capped structured outputs, canaryed model fallback, temporary route rate-limit, tenant quota adjustments.
- Where to watch: fncall_error_rate, kv_cache_evictions, gpu_pool_util, /v1/generate 5xx rate.
- Runbook commands: redwoodctl feature set fncall.enabled=true|false, redwoodctl rollout rollback --route /v1/generate, redwoodctl quota adjust --tenant <id> --revert.
- Customer actions: support whitelist requests for dedicated capacity.
Aisha Khan: handing off to Tom Li and marking incident as mitigation in-progress. I'll be reachable for 30m.
Tom Li: ack, taking over. Will keep bridge open for 20m and check metrics every 60s.
eng-sre-bot: Incident RWI-20260315-22 status changed to: mitigated (partial). Next update required by 1948610983 or on-change.
Marta Rivera: closing loop with support: email batch sent to impacted customers, ticket created for alpha-corp escalation.
Aisha Khan: thanks team. We'll reopen if fncall errors climb or latency creeps.
Tom Li: copying runbook to incident record and will follow up with postmortem once stable.
eng-sre-bot: Note: remember to attach logs and diff of recent batching changes to the postmortem.
